settings.editor: Answers to the questions our guests ask most often.

tabs.tab_title: When is the best time to visit?
tabs.tab_content: Spring (March to May) and autumn (September to November) bring mild days in the mountains and comfortable temperatures in the desert. Winter is great for the Sahara and Marrakech; summer is best for the High Atlas.

tabs.tab_title: How fit do I need to be?
tabs.tab_content: Every tour has a difficulty level. Easy trips suit anyone who is active; moderate and challenging trips need regular riding or hiking. Tell us about your experience and we will recommend the right trip.

tabs.tab_title: Can you tailor a trip for us?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Dates, pace, accommodation and activities can all be adapted, and we can combine biking, hiking and the desert in one journey.

tabs.tab_title: Guided or self-guided – what is the difference?
tabs.tab_content: On guided tours a local guide is with you every day. On self-guided tours you travel at your own pace with GPS routes, a route book, luggage transfers and our support by phone.
Send us your dates and the tour you like. We reply within 24 hours with availability and a detailed proposal.
